title: Malicious code in oc-agent-toolbar-module-client (npm)
description: The oc-agent-toolbar-module-client npm package contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a different, trusted computer. Removing the package alone may not fully eliminate the malicious presence, as the attacker may have established persistent control.
